cases.name: empty_dir
cases.note: an existing directory holding no tracked file

rule: sha256 hex everywhere. file: sha256(bytes). dir: sha256 over "<relpath>\0<sha256hex(file)>\n" per file, sorted bytewise by relpath, relpath relative to the anchor dir with / separators. glob: the same over the matching files (* within a segment, ** any depth, ? one character), relpath relative to the repo root. mode shape: sha256 over "<relpath>\n", sorted the same way. The file set is the git-tracked files at the anchor's commit (ls-tree); without git, a walk that respects .gitignore. A dir: or glob: selecting no file digests the empty input. A file: or dir: target that does not exist is observed null; a glob: never is.
